title: ZorilloCraft Optimized
description: ZorilloCraft Optimized: Smooth, fast, and lag-free Minecraft 1.21.6.
body:
ZorilloCraft Optimized is a performance-focused Minecraft 1.21.6 modpack designed to make your game smooth, fast, and lag-free. It keeps the vanilla feel while using lightweight mods to optimized FPS, reduce memory usage, and usage, and improve overall stability.

Features:

- Bossted FPS with Sodium
- Optimized game logic via Lithium
- Modern lighting with ScalableLux
- Reduced RAM usage through FerriteCore
- Better entity rendering with Entity Culling
- Faster GUI and background performance

Optional enhancments include Iris shaders and a cleaner F3 screen for minimal visual improvements without sacrificing performance.

Perfect for players who want smooth, stable Minecraft without unnecessary bloat.
